eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Rio Arriba, NM; at 6:04 PM on AUG 10, 2026 Effective until 11:04 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
Rio Arriba County Fire Department: 
Due to increased activity on the Frijoles Fire, the community of Cordova is placed in READY status. There is no evacuation order at this time. 

Residents should be prepared in case conditions change. Gather essential items and make a plan to leave. Stay vigilant of changing conditions. 

CHECK facebook.com/RIOARRIBACOUNTY
